title: Doutorado em Matemática Aplicada (seleção 2027/1)
institution: Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), Programa de Pós-Graduação em Matemática Aplicada (PPGMAp)
about: UFRGS Graduate Program in Applied Mathematics (PPGMAp) doctoral selection for 2027/1, with ten places, three under affirmative action. Selection is a single stage based on a preliminary thesis project and documents. Applications run 3 November to 4 December 2026.
requirements: Ten places, three reserved for the affirmative-action programme
Single-stage selection based on a preliminary thesis project and academic document review

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Single-stage selection based on a preliminary thesis project" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."
"academic document review" → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
